title: Arpita Singh, Chronicler of the Inner Lives of Women, Dead at 89
summary: Renowned Indian painter Arpita Singh, whose dreamlike depictions of floating women earned her comparisons to Marc Chagall and influenced generations of artists, died on November 9 in a New Delhi hospital.
